quality.method: Signed corner scaled Jacobian relative to polygon area normal; 3D included corner angles; max/min edge ratio; adjacent polygon area ratio; unique-edge length CV; graph valence; actual count error. Separate from manifold/surface validation.

report.scope: Actual original-input construction from user surface guides. No native process or native output oracle. Geometry validation and methods retained.

quality.method: Signed corner scaled Jacobian relative to polygon area normal; 3D included corner angles; max/min edge ratio; adjacent polygon area ratio; unique-edge length CV; graph valence; actual count error. Separate from manifold/surface validation.

rows.scope: One representative crease per band of parallel creases (the one bordering the wider sheet), joined into chains; chains at least two requested faces in extent are each measured to one connected, forward-ordered output edge path. Distance is from that path to the band span at each chain sample (the strip between the representative and the parallel creases it absorbs); direction over one requested face; the last face of arc at each open end answers to the one-face end limit only. Absorbed and shorter creases remain under the nearest-edge measure.
rows.localFaceScope: Extra faces allowed: a face is the local face at each crease edge (chain extent / 2, at most the requested face, at least 0.25 of it and at least half of the native minimum feature length). The band reach, the two-face minimum, the limits and the end zones use it; values are distances divided by the local face fraction, so they compare with the same limits.

featureValidation.localFaceScope: Extra faces allowed: creases form one band within half of the local face at each crease edge (crease_rows.local_sizes), not half of the requested face; the row check uses the same local faces.
featureValidation.scope: Sampled 30-degree source crease components whose extent is at least one requested edge spacing, to output edges and 30-degree output creases; retained source junctions to output vertices. Smaller angular fragments are counted separately. Creases within 0.5 spacing of another crease branch running within 30 degrees of parallel form one band; their nearest-edge distances are measured beyond the band's local width, and the band's representative crease must carry one connected, ordered edge row measured without that allowance (rows). Exact point-to-segment distances; sampling does not certify every point of each feature. Whole-surface, topology, guide and contact checks are separate.

02.scope: Adaptive triangle subdivision with convex point-to-triangle upper bounds in both directions. Double precision with a roundoff margin; unresolved depth/work budgets reject. Does not check topology or intersections.

13.scope: Adaptive triangle subdivision with convex point-to-triangle upper bounds in both directions. Double precision with a roundoff margin; unresolved depth/work budgets reject. Does not check topology or intersections.

boundaryValidation.method: Matched boundary cycles; adaptive whole-segment convex distance bounds in both directions.

surfaceValidation.scope: Both quad diagonals require adaptive whole-triangle distance bounds in both directions; budgets reject unresolved bounds. Double-precision checks, separate from intersections.

boundaryValidation.method: Matched boundary cycles; adaptive whole-segment convex distance bounds in both directions.

intersectionValidation.scope: Compiled reference contact predicates, no fast-math; 1e-9 length tolerance, 4e-9 shared-boundary tolerance. Both quad diagonals with every mixed pairing when requested; separate topology and degeneracy checks.

cornerZones.scope: Corner zones: source vertices within one requested face of a cluster of crease junctions (three or more admitted crease branches at one vertex; junctions closer than two faces form one corner; zones of fewer than 20 source vertices are left to the whole-surface check). Each zone vertex is measured to the output surface, quads cut along corners 0-2, in requested faces. Source vertices only: the measure follows the source tessellation.
